description: Collect Steam store game records from keyword search, storefront charts, App IDs, or store URLs.

appIds.description: Numeric App IDs or store URLs, one per line. Used when mode is Look up App IDs.
appIds.title: Steam App IDs

appTypeFilter.description: Keep only games, DLC, demos, or software. 'All' keeps every app type Steam returns.
appTypeFilter.title: App type

browseCategory.description: Which storefront chart to browse. Used when mode is Browse a Steam chart.
browseCategory.title: Steam chart

country.description: Two-letter Steam store country code, e.g. us, gb, de, ca. Controls currency and regional availability.
country.title: Store country

includeReviewSummary.description: Add Steam's positive/negative review totals and review label. Adds one request per record.
includeReviewSummary.title: Include review summary

includeTags.description: Read the public store page for its community tags and DLC names. Adds one request per record.
includeTags.title: Include Steam tags

language.description: Language Steam uses for app names, descriptions, and store-page text.
language.title: Store language

maxItems.description: Stop after this many records have been saved.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPrice.description: Keep records whose final price is at or below this amount in the storefront currency. Leave empty for no limit.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minDiscount.description: Keep records whose discount is at least this percentage. 0 disables the filter.
minDiscount.title: Minimum discount (%)

minMetacritic.description: Keep records with a Metacritic score at or above this value. 0 disables the filter.
minMetacritic.title: Minimum Metacritic score

mode.description: Choose how to find games: keyword search, a Steam chart, specific App IDs, or pasted store URLs.
enumTitles: Featured mix (top sellers, new, specials, coming soon)
mode.title: Mode

onlyDiscounted.description: Drop records that are not currently on sale.
onlyDiscounted.title: Only discounted games

searchQueries.description: One or more game names or keywords. Used when mode is Search by keyword.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: How Steam should order search and chart results before filtering.
sortBy.title: Sort order

storeUrls.description: Full store URLs, one per line. Used when mode is Paste store URLs.
storeUrls.title: Steam store URLs

title: Steam Store Games Scraper Input
